title: CaaS: The Infrastructure Layer
description:
How the world's largest banks and brokerages build digital asset products on Coinbase infrastructure.

✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

#coinbase #crypto #bitcoin #blockchain #finance

asr.full_text: What does the future hold? Thank you, Justin. Now, the progress we're making on top of Prime is really incredible. My job is to build on that. I'm Alec Lovett and I lead infrastructure products at Coinbase. As you've heard from Rick and Justin, we've been building leading institutional products for more than a decade and as we built we've made the underlying capabilities available as infrastructure and API's in a product that we call crypto as a service we work with banks brokers and fintechs to power a range of payment stable coin and trading use cases zooming out crypto is rapidly updating the financial services we use every day there are over 700 million global crypto owners stablecoins power 9 trillion dollars in annual transactions and consumers are trading over 200 billion dollars of crypto every day. Innovative financial institutions understand this shift, and many of them are racing to integrate crypto into their products. Today, many of the best companies in the world are building on our infrastructure, including banks like JPMorgan, Citi, PNC and payment companies like Shopify and checkout.com. Our customers choose Coinbase as their Infrastructure Partner for our trust, scale, and innovation. We are the gold standard in the market on security and compliance. We offer global infrastructure, both regulated and self-custodial. And we've just launched a flexible domain model that serves both human and agentic use cases with our APIs. Now to make this tangible, I want to go one level deeper on the product stack that we offer to our customers. Stablecoin Payments are the fastest growing use case in crypto, and they are transforming money movement with faster, cheaper, and more global rails. There are three critical parts of the crypto payments equation, stablecoins, high throughput blockchains, and API product infrastructure. Our crypto services and product suite is leading the way on each dimension on stablecoins where the co-creators of USDC and top of market revenue share is embedded in all of our products. We also support major non-USD stable coins and non-dollar stable coins like Ero-C. Recently we launched a custom stable coin product that allows our customers to issue their own branded stable coins. On block chains, our in-house blockchain base is purpose-built for enterprise payments, but we're also a platform and support leading chains like Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon. And lastly, on product infrastructure, we've leveraged our massive headstart in Coinbase Custody, and stable coin mint burn to build a world class and payments API stack that includes merchant payments, payouts, deposits, and global wallet infrastructure. Now, you heard a lot about the prime brokerage capabilities that make us the undisputed number one platform for institutional trading, and those same capabilities power our trading APIs. Our APIs are dead simple to integrate and enable your customers to buy, sell and hold crypto assets. We also offer the advanced features your customers want, like Coinbase's Multi Venue Algo brokerage and access for your users to 10X leverage. 24-by-7 trading, futures and options. These products are fully white labeled infrastructure, but leverage the tech that powers Coinbase Prime and the Retail Coinbase App. All of this comes together, so you can focus on growing your business, while we handle the tech behind the scenes. Our crypto-as-a-service product has the infrastructure and depth to get you started and to help you scale with confidence.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents Coinbase infrastructure and API offerings for banks, brokerages, fintechs, payments, stablecoins, and trading. Although it discusses enabling business customers to let users buy, sell, and hold assets, it is described as informational and does not directly request viewers to invest, pay money, or provide private data.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central subject is a commercial infrastructure service for financial institutions, including payment and trading APIs, rather than a viewer-facing investment-return offer.
